text: The test suite has been red for two days. Get it green.
Two things happen each round — fix, then run everything — and it goes round again only if it is still red. Up to three rounds.

input.goal: Get the test suite green again

content: Plan proposed; waiting for the user.

plan.title: Get the test suite green again

steps.until: the whole test suite passes with no failures and no skipped tests
steps.title: Fix and re-run until the suite is green
steps.summary: Fix what is broken, run everything, and go round again if it is still red.
steps.task: Keep fixing and re-running until the suite is green, or until three rounds are up.

body.title: Fix the failing tests in this area
body.summary: Two helpers each take one failing area and try a fix.

body.title: Run the whole suite and say whether it is green
body.summary: One helper runs everything and says whether the suite is green yet.
body.task: Run the whole test suite. Answer in the required form: satisfied when every test passes, not satisfied otherwise, with the failing names.
